free_tier.stated: "Curious? Try our Ultimate Bucket for just €1" and "Try our Ultimate Bucket for just €1! 2 days - 400 Mbit* - 25 connections - Unlimited traffic - SSL-support - 1600 days retention". The page's meta description still advertises "Try us 7 days for free, no strings attached!"
free_tier.notes: The meta description and the rendered page disagree: 7 days free in the HTML head, 2 days for €1 in the body. The record keeps the rendered offer, which is the one a buyer sees, and treats the meta sentence as stale SEO. Neither is a free trial: €1 is a payment.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap is published. The unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, roughly 750 KB by convention.

retention.stated: "1600 days retention" on every Bucket row and in the trial line.

egress.terms: "Unlimited traffic" on all four buckets; no overage price is published.
egress.free_allowance: 2 days at 400 Mbit with 25 connections, for €1

interface_detail: NNTP over SSL. The schema has no nntp token, so the array says unknown.

limits.value: 15 Mbit on Basic, 60 Mbit on Comfort, 400 Mbit on Ultimate

binding_note: The €1 trial is two days with unlimited traffic, so the only cap is 400 Mbit over 48 h: 50 MB/s x 172,800 s = 8.64 TB. The paid 30-day Basic bucket at 15 Mbit is the step that binds at 1 TiB/month (about 4.9 TB/month ceiling).

identity_cost.detail: The €1 trial is bought: the page says "Secure Payments - All payments are safely processed by certified payment providers", and there is no zero-price path on the site. The exact instrument was not read at checkout.

reliability_note: Prices are per 30 days, not per calendar month; nothing about suspension was read.
confidence_note: The rendered €1 / 2-day offer and the 400 Mbit / 25-connection terms are quoted from the vendor page today. The conflict with the site's own meta description is recorded rather than resolved.

evidence.proved: "Try our Ultimate Bucket for just €1", "2 days - 400 Mbit* - 25 connections - Unlimited traffic", "1600 days retention", and the Basic/Comfort/Ultimate price rows at €2.95 / €4.95 / €12.95 per 30 days
The order page repeats the same €1 line and "All payments are safely processed by certified payment providers"; no 7-day free offer appears in the body

notes: Repeatability: no vendor sentence exists. A €1 purchase is repeatable only by paying again, so there is nothing to repeat for free. Abandonment: if the €1 line is removed the record becomes paid-only.
